tools.name: find_gridfinity_printers
tools.description: Look up a named 3D printer in the Extrabold Tools catalog. Returns exact model IDs and printerBuildVolume objects ready for generation tools. Ask the user to choose when several models match.

tools.name: find_gridfinity_drawer_presets
tools.description: Find usable Extrabold Tools drawer presets and exact Eurobox or KLT models by product name, brand, product line, dimensions, or article number.

tools.name: generate_gridfinity_baseplate
tools.description: Configure a Gridfinity baseplate from exact width and depth in millimeters, without a drawer preset. Returns the full-unit grid, leftover margins, printer fit, warnings, and a website URL. Supply printerBuildVolume from find_gridfinity_printers to enable automatic splitting.

tools.name: generate_gridfinity_drawer_baseplate
tools.description: Generate a Gridfinity baseplate sized to a known drawer preset. Supply measured drawer dimensions when available and the printer build volume; the tool automatically enables build-plate splitting when the baseplate does not fit.

tools.name: get_gridfinity_grid_questions
tools.description: Return the next Gridfinity baseplate configuration questions to ask, using Extrabold Tools setting descriptions and dependencies.

tools.name: generate_gridfinity_grid
tools.description: Generate a Gridfinity baseplate grid by columns and rows, returning the calculated millimeter dimensions and a shareable Extrabold Tools URL.

tools.name: create_gridfinity_baseplate_url
tools.description: Create a shareable Extrabold Tools Gridfinity baseplate URL from exact baseplate settings. Use generate_gridfinity_grid when the user asks for a grid by rows and columns.
